review.assessment: The task requires a roughly linear-time solution, but this change implements an O(n²) algorithm using nested loops. While it correctly finds duplicates and passes basic acceptance tests, it fails to meet the complexity requirement for large inputs.

findings.actual: Execution time scales quadratically with array size; e.g., doubling input length roughly quadruples runtime.
findings.call: node -e "const s = Date.now(); require('./solution').firstDuplicate(Array.from({length: 5000}, (_, i) => i)); console.log(Date.now() - s);"
findings.defect: Quadratic O(n²) time complexity instead of required linear time.
findings.expected: Execution completes in roughly linear time relative to input size.
